scenes.title: Make it comfy
scenes.caption: This site changes to suit you.
scenes.say: Reading is hard work for a lot of people. So this website changes to suit you. Look for Make it comfy, at the top of every page.

scenes.title: The letters
scenes.caption: Bigger. Roomier. Or made for dyslexia.
scenes.say: You can make the letters bigger, or give them more room. And there are letters made for dyslexia, too.

scenes.title: The paper
scenes.caption: Cream, a soft tint, or dark.
scenes.say: You can change the colour of the paper. Cream, a soft tint, or dark, if a bright page dazzles you.

scenes.title: Keep your place
scenes.caption: A ruler follows your finger.
scenes.say: There is a ruler to keep your place. It follows your pointer, or your finger, and dims everything else.

scenes.title: Hear any words
scenes.caption: Press them, and they are read to you.
scenes.say: And you can have any words on the site read out. Just press them. That voice is not me, mind. It is your own device's.

scenes.title: It stays with you
scenes.caption: Remembered on your device. Nowhere else.
scenes.say: Whatever you choose is remembered on your own device, and nowhere else. Go on. Get comfy.
